attestation_rule: All required runtime values must be measured on the running destination and match exactly before development release. Image or GPU labels alone are insufficient.
rehydration_rule: Only content-addressed non-development artifacts may be present before admission.
development_rule: Development remains absent until a no-clobber admission receipt authenticates this authority, the destination, the current ledger tail, the frozen H6 package, both checkpoints, both reports, the tokenizer, and the training-only primary selection.
